correctness.rationale: The fourth-order Fibonacci-cube recurrence reduces the infinite gcd to four terms. A determinant-2 evaluation comparison reduces it to the four polynomial coefficients except possibly one factor 2. Cassini, doubling identities, the prime 3 valuation correction exactly for 8|k, and a separate 2-adic witness determine the coefficient content and eliminate the only ambiguity. verify.py independently confirms all k<=500 with exact big integers; finite results are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The finite-value-free universal formula concerns the exact greatest modulus of congruence shifts of cubed Fibonacci numbers. The inspected recurrence, classical Pisano period, consecutive-sum-square papers, and actual research-record hits do not state it or logically imply the cubic 3-adic correction. No negative search by itself proves novelty.

value.rationale: An exact maximum period modulus for every positive shift is a natural unknown arithmetic invariant of the cubed Fibonacci sequence. The theorem identifies a genuine 3-adic period-shortening phenomenon (shift 8 modulo 9) not implied by ordinary Pisano periods and supplies a sharp uniform all-parameter Fibonacci–Lucas classification. This is more than recomputation of a short numerical table.
